mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST is above 500.0 (a level observed in the current snapshot).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS at 130848.0 and UNRATE at 10.2 (asof t-1mo)
failure_condition: In periods where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 100), industrial production is below trend, leading to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate capacity, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 100), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and Fed policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 5.0%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST at 590.0 and RSAFS at 344688.0 (asof t-2mo)
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 215), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to anticipated monetary policy tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 215), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to trend signals weak supply chain activity, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is below 100, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
